title: Secret Santa gifts under $60
say: Four small objects from Craighill, in brass and steel, that nobody regifts. The shop's own photos and prices.
description: Secret Santa gift ideas under $60 from Craighill: an enameled keyring, a brass bookmark, a steel money clip and a cuff. Prices in dollars, photos from the shop.
